snippet.title: Audio Trip - Award-winning VR Dance Game!  [Oculus Trailer Fall 2020]
snippet.description:
Dance in VR! Join our growing worldwide community in the award-winning VR dance game Audio Trip, available on Oculus: ocul.us/2WEORIu

Featuring music from your favorite artists: Lady Gaga, Skrillex, Zedd, deadmau5, Tiësto, and more. Catch gems, ride ribbons, dodge barriers, and smash drums on YOUR Audio Trip!

Special thanks to ANABURN for showing off her moves in mixed reality! Check out her page here:
https://www.youtube.com/c/ANABURN

And thank you to LSToast for his awesome dancing! See his sick barrel roll move at 0:27 :0
Check out more of his moves on his page:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLnTcASkvbFLQI2Jeo50HdA

And thank you to all of our Trippers worldwide! Come join us on Discord as we continue to develop the game!
http://audio.chat

Follow us on socials: @audiotripvr

Keep Dancing!
~Kinemotik
